name: PivotLines
description: The PivotLines object is a collection of lines in a PivotTable, containing all lines on rows or columns of the pivot. Each line is a set of PivotCell objects.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified PivotLines object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a specific element of the PivotLines collection object by its position in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the PivotLines collection. Read-only.
